description: This file defines a handler class for creating share products within the Fineract system. It implements the command processing interface and delegates the creation logic to the ShareProductWritePlatformService.

classes.name: CreateShareProductCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class implementing command handling for creating share products, annotated with command type and transactional behavior, delegating creation to the relevant service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command by calling the createShareProduct method of the shareProductWritePlatformService.
